segments.name: Technical equipment and processes
segments.description: Sells machines including installation, long-term development and extended warranties to industrial customers.
segments.evidence: Technical equipment and processes includes mainly the sale of machines including installation and extended warranties.

segments.name: Spare parts and services
segments.description: Sells spare parts and provides repair, modification and inspection services for machines.
segments.evidence: Spare parts and services includes the sale of spare parts as well as services including repairs, modifications of machines and inspections.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay the company for machines, spare parts and services including repairs and inspections.
revenueModel.evidence: We principally finance our operations through cash generated from the sale of machines, spare parts and services.
